name: Songyan Zhang

papers.title: GeoWorldAD: Geometry World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Autonomous driving requires safe and efficient planning in complex, open-world environments. Although recent Vision/Video-Action models learn action-relevant representations directly from visual observations, trajectory planning is fundamentally constrained by scene geometry, such as drivable space, obstacles, dynamic agents, and their spatial relationships. In this work, we propose GeoWorldAD, a unified video geometry world-action model that provides planning with explicit geometric priors over both present observations and future scene evolution. Built upon a streaming video geometry foundation model, GeoWorldAD extracts ego-aligned, multi-scale geometry tokens from current observations to provide fine-grained spatial constraints. A Q-Former-style geometry world model then learns latent future tokens to model short-horizon geometric evolution, supervised by future depth prediction and conditioned on ego states. Compared with pixel-level future prediction, geometry prediction offers a compact, action-relevant abstraction directly aligned with planning constraints. Finally, a geometry-oriented action model iteratively aggregates present and future geometry tokens to refine trajectory proposals, enabling safer and more efficient planning. Extensive experiments on NavSim v1 and v2 demonstrate that GeoWorldAD achieves state-of-the-art closed-loop performance with improved driving safety.
